payload.text: If devbin-vc does not take it with the sweep: add intent/.canon/** beside intent/whiteboard/** in tests.yml's paths-ignore, and correct my sentence 'a push that only moves the whiteboard runs nothing', which is false as written -- paths-ignore suppresses only when EVERY changed file matches, and intent wb writes a canon event outside the ignored path (vc measured 2 of 61 runs suppressed as committed, 18 of 61 with the canon line).
